decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's library. It also utilizes cards like Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to manipulate artifacts and bring back key pieces from the graveyard. Agatha's Soul Cauldron provides additional card draw and graveyard recursion, while disruption is offered through red elemental blast and pyroblast. The deck aims to control the game with cards like Ensnaring Bridge and Chaos Defiler, ultimately winning through the combo or with damage from Lightning Bolt.

The deck focuses on quickly getting powerful creatures into the graveyard using cards like Entomb and Grief, then bringing them back onto the battlefield using Reanimate and Animate Dead. It utilizes cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Daze to dig through the deck and protect its combo pieces. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with disruptive creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while also controlling the board with counterspells like Force of Will and Wasteland. The deck aims to win through a combination of controlling the board and quickly reanimating powerful threats.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through a combination of counter spells, removal, and card draw. It also utilizes land destruction and recursion to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The creatures in the deck provide additional value through card advantage and pressure on the opponent. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the color requirements of the spells in the deck, allowing for consistent and efficient gameplay. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent through a combination of disruption and card advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing Gaea's Cradle to generate mana quickly, allowing for explosive plays with creatures like Endurance, Elvish Reclaimer, and Green Sun's Zenith. The deck also utilizes control elements like Bojuka Bog and Collector Ouphe to disrupt the opponent's strategies. The inclusion of cards like Wight of the Reliquary and Atraxa, Grand Unifier provide additional options for dealing with threats and maintaining board presence. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through efficient mana generation and versatile creature options.

The main concept of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Lotus Petal and Mox Diamond to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as It That Heralds the End and Thought-Knot Seer. The deck also utilizes cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's strategy and control the board. With the aggressive creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and Eldrazi Linebreaker, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and powerful creatures while utilizing lands like Eye of Ugin and Eldrazi Temple for additional mana advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Grief, and then bring them back onto the battlefield with Reanimate and Animate Dead. This allows the player to bypass traditional casting costs and potentially win the game with high-impact creatures like Archon of Cruelty. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo, while utilizing cards like Brainstorm and Ponder for card selection and manipulation.

The main goal of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Grief, and then bring them back onto the battlefield with Reanimate and Animate Dead spells. By comboing off early in the game, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Daze and Force of Will helps to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck is focused on efficiently reanimating creatures to gain a strategic advantage and win the game.

Utilize graveyard manipulation to quickly bring back powerful creatures and disrupt opponent's strategy. Use cards like Entomb and Reanimate to quickly put creatures into the graveyard and bring them back onto the battlefield. Use counterspells like Force of Will to protect your combo pieces and disrupt your opponent's plays. Wasteland and Daze provide additional disruption to slow down your opponent while you set up your combo. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and powerful creature reanimation while controlling the game with counterspells and disruption spells.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then bringing them back to the battlefield with cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate. It also includes disruption elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo and control the game. A key strategy is to reanimate a creature with a strong enters-the-battlefield effect, like Archon of Cruelty or Atraxa, Grand Unifier, to gain a significant advantage. This deck focuses on using the combo of Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Nomads en-Kor to draw through the deck quickly and find key pieces while protecting the combo with counterspells like Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Swords to Plowshares and sideboard options like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Endurance. The mana base is designed to support the varied color requirements of the deck, with key lands like Karakas and Boseiju, Who Endures providing additional utility.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard, such as Griselbrand and Ashen Rider, using cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead. The deck also utilizes cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to accelerate its game plan, while disruptive spells like Unmask and Thoughtseize help to protect the combo pieces. By leveraging the combination of graveyard manipulation and powerful reanimation spells, this deck aims to overwhelm and outpace its opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to rapidly deploy powerful artifacts and creatures, while disrupting the opponent's strategy. The combination of aggressive creatures like Broadside Bombardiers and efficient removal like Lightning Bolt allows the deck to close out the game quickly. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and The One Ring provide additional value and versatility to outmaneuver opposing strategies.
